Plugin.Name: Storage History
Plugin.Description:
Storage History adds a native capacity-history tile to the Unraid Dashboard for traditional arrays and pool-only systems.
Features: - Adaptive used-space history with hover details and selectable ranges - Current used, free, and total capacity with average daily growth - Remaining-capacity estimates after enough history has been collected - Live aggregate physical-disk read and write meters - Collection-health states and configurable sampling and retention
